propositions: git commit --amend -F <file> or --amend -m replaces the entire commit message, dropping the Change-Id trailer and causing Gerrit to stamp a new Change-Id, creating a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
prepare-commit-msg hook cannot distinguish an amending -F invocation from a fresh -F commit, so a hook-based guard is not viable
A make amend-msg FILE=<path> wrapper must amend HEAD with FILE's contents while preserving the existing Change-Id trailer from HEAD's message
make amend-msg must fail loudly when HEAD carries no Change-Id, indicating the commit-msg hook is not installed
AGENTS.md documentation must name make amend-msg as the required path for rewritten commit messages and explicitly warn that --amend -m/-F drop the Change-Id and create duplicate Gerrit changes
